# Templates

Reusable model templates and supporting documentation. These are starting points to adapt and validate, **not** engine development plans or production-ready example applications.

- [Per-position product lifecycle BPMN](lebenszyklus-pro-position/README.md) — an ADR-0428 lifecycle model, diagram and adaptation notes.

For installable end-to-end examples, see [examples](../../examples/). For planned atlas engineering work, see [planning](../planning/README.md).
